answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32165 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Vitr namaz mein dua qunoot na yaad ho to kia karna hai? Question: Vitr namaz mein dua qunoot na yaad ho to kia karna hai? Answer ID: 32165 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1028/646/H=1432) He should read any dua mentioned in Quran and hadith, for example: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ . Or he should read رب اغفرلى three times or more. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
